name: Collect Moses' Gift
summary: Moses' last side job: after every requested car is delivered, a unique Sultan waits in the small garage beside his shop.
body: PowerPyx lists Collect Moses' Gift as an optional side mission given by Moses, starting at his shop in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, and playable as Lucia or Jason.
PowerPyx says it opens once every vehicle in Steal Vehicles for Moses has been delivered, when Moses texts that a gift is waiting at his shop.
PowerPyx gives the questline order as Moses, Daily Driver, Steal Vehicles for Moses, then Collect Moses' Gift.
PowerPyx says the reward, Moses' Sultan, is a unique Street Racer kept behind the door of the smaller garage next to the main one, and that it can be sold or registered and kept.

facts.location: Moses' shop, Port Gellhorn, Kelly County

name: Catch A Bigger Fish
summary: Cal's Chapter 1 fishing challenge for Jason: land a Stoplight Parrotfish heavier than 2 lb at a marked spot in Gambit Bay.
body: PowerPyx lists Catch A Bigger Fish as a side quest from Cal, starting in Gambit Bay, Mariana County, and playable only as Jason.
PowerPyx says Cal texts the challenge after the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, asking for a Stoplight Parrotfish over 2 lb.
PowerPyx says that after Chapter 1 the boat at Jason's house is gone, so a boat has to be taken elsewhere; it suggests the docks near The Rusty Anchor, where fishing boats usually sit.
PowerPyx says the anchor is dropped from the vehicle menu (hold Left on the D-pad, then the right stick up).
PowerPyx gives the reward as a Focus increase and the Baited My Tackle trophy or achievement.

facts.reward: Focus increase; Baited My Tackle trophy
